_note: The Infusion Monitor. Takes the Thaumonomicon as its key - the book is what gives it sight, and the recipe says so by consuming one. A coalescence core to read the altar's aura, an infusion altar's own pillar stone for the frame, and salis mundus to bind the book to the machine. 50 vis, with warp: the 1.12.2 tree puts this behind the infusion provider and gives it a cost in more than materials.
